Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: A single daily income or expense transaction in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT).

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the transaction owner.

amount.description: Positive monetary amount in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT).

category.description: Category key for expenses (e.g. FOOD, TRANSPORT) or income source (e.g. SALARY, INCOME).

description.description: Optional or income note describing the transaction.

transactionDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the transaction date.

updatedAt.description: Server-assigned last modification timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Per-user subcollection storing all daily income and expense records.
